DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 講座のご案内をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for information about courses?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人に「かいご」の講座を勧められました。でも私のメモは「かいわ」になっていて、何の講座か取り違えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: かいごとかいわをメモで取り違えたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: A friend recommended a “kaigo” course. But my note says “kaiwa,” so I've mixed up what kind of course it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mixed up kaigo and kaiwa in your note. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 学びたい内容は、ご自身では何でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What is it that you yourself would like to learn?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 仕事で日本語を話す練習をしたいです。介護の資格を取る講座を探しているわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 希望は職場日本語会話で介護資格ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to practice speaking Japanese at work. I'm not looking for a course to obtain a caregiving qualification.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want workplace Japanese conversation, not a caregiving qualification. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、会話の練習を扱う講座について担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then I'll ask the person in charge about a course that offers conversation practice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名称の音だけで申込むのはやめます。この案内の「対象」という欄も、私が参加できるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 音だけで申込まず対象欄を確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't apply based only on how the name sounds. I'd also like to check the “eligibility” section in this information to see whether I can participate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not apply based on the sound alone and want to check the eligibility section. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 講座ごとに対象や内容が異なりますので、その案内を担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Eligibility and content differ by course, so please show that information to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内を持って相談します。友人が参加したから私も必ず入れる、とは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人参加と本人参加資格を同一視せず案内を担当へ持参する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll bring the information when I ask. I won't assume that I can definitely join just because my friend attended.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Bring the information to the person in charge without equating your friend's participation with your own eligibility. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望の時間帯もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have a preferred time of day too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 仕事の後を希望しますが、夜の講座があるかはまだ知りません。内容と対象を先に確認してから日程を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 夜開催を断定せず内容と対象確認後に日程選択すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd prefer after work, but I don't yet know whether there are evening courses. I'll check the content and eligibility before choosing a schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Without assuming evening sessions exist, say you will choose dates after checking content and eligibility. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 希望を添えて担当へご案内します。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll refer you to the person in charge along with your preferences. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査室へご案内する前に、お話を聞いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before I take you to the examination room, could you listen to this explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。工場から来て、仕事用の耳栓をしたままでした。説明の一部を聞き逃しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事用耳栓の着用に気づき聞き逃しを申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry. I came from the factory and still had my work earplugs in. I missed part of the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Notice that you are still wearing work earplugs and report that you missed some of the explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 耳栓を外して、もう一度ご説明しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please remove the earplugs, and I'll explain again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 外しました。首に掛けるひもも付いていますが、これは検査の前にどうすればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 耳栓を外し首ひも付きの扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've removed them. There is also a cord that goes around my neck. What should I do with it before the examination?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Remove the earplugs and ask how to handle their neck cord. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 検査の準備について、担当へ確認します。自己判断で着けたままにせずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask the person in charge about examination preparations. Please wait rather than deciding yourself to leave it on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ひもも外してケースに入れます。耳栓を医療用の器具だと思われないよう、仕事で使う物だと伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ひもも収納し仕事用と担当へ伝えるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll take off the cord too and put it in its case. Please tell them these are for work, so they do not mistake the earplugs for medical equipment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put away the cord too and ask that the person in charge be told these are for work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 仕事用の物ということを申し送ります。説明は今、聞こえていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass on that they are work equipment. Can you hear the explanation now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、聞こえます。最初に聞き逃した検査前の注意だけ、もう一度お願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 聴取可能を報告し冒頭の注意再説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I can hear. Please repeat just the precautions before the examination that I missed at the beginning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that you can hear and ask for the initial precautions to be explained again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から注意を改めてご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain the precautions again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。聞こえないままうなずかず、説明を確認してから検査室へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 聞こえないまま同意せず説明確認後に進むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I won't nod without hearing; I'll confirm the explanation before going to the examination room.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not agree without hearing and will proceed after confirming the explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当を呼びます。この場所でお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll call the person in charge. Please wait here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の内容を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what you would like to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅で道を聞かれ、近所の目印を説明するつもりで自宅の住所まで教えました。その人から家へ行くと言われて不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所を教えた見知らぬ人の訪問発言への不安を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone asked me directions at the station, and while I meant to explain a neighborhood landmark, I even gave them my home address. They said they would come to my home, and I'm worried.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Seek advice about your concern after a stranger you gave your address to said they would visit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 面識のある方でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 初めて会った人です。連絡先は交換していませんし、訪問をお願いしたこともありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 面識連絡先交換も訪問依頼もないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was someone I met for the first time. We didn't exchange contact details, and I never asked them to visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not know them, exchange contact details or invite them to visit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 来る日時や目的について、何か言っていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Did they say anything about when or why they would come?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日時は言いませんでした。「今度寄る」とだけです。冗談だったとは自分では判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 日時なしの発言を引用し冗談とは断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: They didn't say a date or time. They only said, “I'll stop by sometime.” I can't determine for myself that it was a joke.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Quote the statement without a date or time and do not assume it was a joke. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その場での会話や相手の特徴を、覚えている範囲でお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell me as much as you remember about the conversation and the person's appearance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青い上着でした。名前と年齢は分かりません。見た目から国籍を決めて話すこともしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見た服装と不明な氏名年齢国籍を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: They wore a blue jacket. I don't know their name or age. I won't guess their nationality based on appearance either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish observed clothing from unknown name, age and nationality. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同じ家にお住まいの方には、状況を伝えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you told the people you live with about this?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだです。住所を伝えた事実と訪問の言葉だけを共有します。今、家の前にいると確認したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同居者へ確認済み事実だけ伝え現在所在は未確認と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not yet. I'll share only the fact that I gave my address and the words about visiting. I haven't confirmed that they are outside my home now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will share only confirmed facts with your household and that their current whereabouts are unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況を確認して対応を相談しましょう。お話しいただきありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's check the situation and discuss how to respond. Thank you for telling me. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお手紙をお送りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to send this letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手紙に押し花を添えましたが、封筒を持つと中で折れる音がしました。このまま渡す前に見直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 押し花入り手紙の破損音に気づき受付前の見直しを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I included pressed flowers in the letter, but when I held the envelope I heard something breaking inside. I'd like to check it again before handing it over like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Notice a breaking sound in the letter containing pressed flowers and ask to review it before acceptance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだお預かりしていませんので、中身はご自身でお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We haven't accepted it yet, so please check the contents yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開けました。花びらが一枚割れていました。破片が手紙に散らばっているので、まず取り除きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 花びら破損を見て手紙上の破片を除くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've opened it. One petal was broken. Pieces are scattered over the letter, so I'll remove them first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you saw the broken petal and will remove the fragments from the letter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入れる物を決めてから、外装についても確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Once you decide what to put inside, let's also check the outer packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今回は花を入れず、写真に撮った物を手紙へ添えます。壊れた花をテープで封筒の外へ貼るのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 押し花を写真へ替え封筒外へ花を貼らないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: This time I won't include the flower; I'll enclose a photo of it with the letter. I won't tape the broken flower to the outside of the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to replace the pressed flower with a photo and not attach the flower outside the envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真と手紙をお送りになるということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: So you will be sending the photo and the letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。封筒を開けた時に端が破れたので、この封筒を補修して使えるか見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開封で破れた封筒の再利用可否を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. The edge tore when I opened the envelope, so could you check whether I can repair and reuse this envelope?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the envelope torn on opening can be reused. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 状態を見て、必要なら別の封筒をご用意いただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check its condition, and if necessary ask you to prepare a different envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 無理にこのまま出さず、丈夫な封筒へ入れ直します。押し花は自分で持ち帰り、写真と手紙だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 丈夫な封筒へ移し花を持帰り写真と手紙だけ送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't force myself to send it like this; I'll put it in a sturdy envelope instead. I'll take the pressed flower home and send only the photo and letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Transfer to a sturdy envelope, take the flower home, and send just the photo and letter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備ができましたら改めてお声を掛けてください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please let us know again once you're ready. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お預かりした紙の中に、同じお名前を何度も書いた物がございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Among the papers you handed us is one with the same name written repeatedly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: それは署名を練習した紙です。申込書の間に挟んだまま、全部渡してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 署名練習紙を誤って提出したと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: That is a sheet I used to practice my signature. I left it between the application forms and handed everything over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you accidentally submitted your signature practice sheet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは申込みの書類ではないということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: So this is not an application document?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、練習用です。筆記具を変えて何度も書いたので、違う人の署名があるという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 繰返し署名は他人でなく筆記具を変えた練習と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it's for practice. I wrote it repeatedly using different pens, so it doesn't mean there are signatures from different people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the repeated signatures are practice with different writing instruments, not other people's signatures. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 練習紙はお返しします。提出する書類をもう一度区別しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll return the practice sheet. Let's separate the documents you are submitting again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受け取りました。この紙は個人の署名がたくさんあるので、窓口のごみ箱へ捨てず、自分で持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返却紙を窓口で捨てず本人が持帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've received it. Since the sheet has many personal signatures, I won't throw it in the counter's bin; I'll take it home myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will take the returned sheet home rather than discard it at the counter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 申込書の署名について、不明な点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there anything unclear about signing the application?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 練習で一番きれいに書けた形を切って貼るのではなく、書類の該当欄へ自分で書くという理解でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 練習署名の切貼りではなく本人記入か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Am I right that I should write it myself in the relevant space on the document rather than cut out and paste the neatest practice signature?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you should sign personally rather than cut and paste the practice signature. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この書類では、所定の欄へご本人にご記入いただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: For this document, the applicant must write it in the designated space themselves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。該当欄を確認して書きます。提出するのは申込書だけで、練習紙はかばんへしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 所定欄記入と練習紙収納後の提出物を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll check the relevant space and write it. I'm submitting only the application form, and I've put the practice sheet in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the document to submit after writing in the designated space and putting away the practice sheet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 申込書を確認いたします。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check the application form. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お客様、そちらの棒はこちらへ置いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Excuse me, could you put that bar here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 前の人の買物に混ざった品かと思って、仕切り棒を自分のかごへ入れてしまいました。お店の道具なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕切り棒を購入品と思いかごへ入れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought it was an item mixed in with the previous customer's shopping and put the divider bar into my own basket. So it is a store tool.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the divider bar for a purchased item and put it in your basket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、買物の区切りを示す物です。前のお客様との間に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, it marks the boundary between purchases. Please put it between your items and the previous customer's.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この位置に戻します。私の品は棒の後ろで、前の人の品が一つだけこちらへ転がってきています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 棒を区切り位置へ戻し他客の商品が転がったと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll return it to this position. My items are behind the bar, but one of the previous customer's items has rolled over to this side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Return the bar to the dividing position and point out that another customer's item rolled over. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その品は前のお客様に確認します。勝手に混ぜず、お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check that item with the previous customer. Please wait without mixing it in yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私が選んだのはこのパンと牛乳だけです。転がった品も自分の物だと一緒に支払わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の購入品二点を示し他客品の混合支払いを避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I chose only this bread and milk. I'll make sure not to pay for the rolled item as though it were mine too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify your two purchases and avoid paying for another customer's item mixed in with them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 前のお客様の品と確認できましたので、分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We've confirmed it belongs to the previous customer, so I'll separate it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。会計が始まったら仕切り棒は自分で持ち帰らず、店員さんの所へ残せばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会計後の棒を持帰らず店に残すと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Once checkout starts, should I leave the divider bar with the cashier rather than take it home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you should leave the bar at the store rather than take it home after checkout. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらで戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we'll put it back here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。区切るための道具と購入品を分けて、パンと牛乳の会計をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 道具と購入品を区別し本人二点の会計を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll distinguish the dividing tool from the purchases. Please ring up the bread and milk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the tool from purchases and request checkout for your own two items. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二点を確認いたします。ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check the two items. Thank you. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遊具の入口を少し空けていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you please keep the entrance to the play equipment clear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自撮りの準備で、滑り台へ上がる所に三脚を置いていました。子どもの通り道だと気づきませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 滑り台入口へ自撮り三脚を置いたと認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put a tripod where people climb up the slide while preparing a selfie. I didn't realize it was the children's access route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Acknowledge placing a selfie tripod at the slide entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず三脚をたたんで、入口から移してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: First fold up the tripod and move it away from the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: たたみました。空いている今だけなら置いてよいと思いましたが、人が来てから動かすのでは遅いですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三脚をたたみ来客後移動では遅いと理解を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've folded it. I thought I could leave it there just while nobody was around, but waiting until someone arrives to move it is too late.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Fold the tripod and show you understand moving it after someone arrives is too late. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 遊具を使う場所とは別に、周囲を確認して撮影してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please take photos away from the area where the play equipment is used, after checking your surroundings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 遊具の上から撮るのもやめます。地面で短く撮り、遊んでいる子が映る向きは避けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 遊具上での撮影をやめ子どもを映さない向きを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll also stop taking photos from on the play equipment. I'll take a few quick shots from the ground and avoid angles that include children playing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Stop taking photos on the play equipment and choose a direction that does not capture children. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その際も、通路をふさがないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even then, please do not block the paths.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 背景に子どもが入った写真は使いません。撮り直すために、その子へどいてと言うこともしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子ども入り写真を使わず撮影のため退かせないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't use photos with children in the background. I won't ask a child to move so I can retake a photo either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not use photos containing children or make them move for your photos. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの方が遊ぶ時間を妨げずにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do not interfere with other people's playtime.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は三脚なしで撮ります。遊具の入口が空いたか、もう一度振り返って確かめました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三脚なしへ変更し遊具入口の空き状態を再確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I'll take photos without the tripod. I looked back once more and checked that the play equipment entrance was clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Switch to no tripod and recheck that the entrance is clear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、失礼します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗り換えのことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need help with a train connection?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 次の駅で乗り換えます。昼食を買いたいのですが、乗り換え中に売店へ寄れるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 接続中の昼食購入について尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll transfer at the next station. I'd like to buy lunch and want to know whether I can stop at a shop during the transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about buying lunch during a connection. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この接続では移動を含めて六分です。乗り換えホームには売店がなく、売店は別の改札の外です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have six minutes for this connection, including walking. There is no shop on the transfer platform; the shop is outside a different ticket gate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 売店は別の改札の外なのですね。六分で買って戻るのは難しそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 六分と改札外売店のため購入が難しいと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The shop is outside a different ticket gate, then. Buying something and getting back in six minutes sounds difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand that six minutes and the shop outside the gate make buying lunch difficult. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今こちらで買うなら、次の列車まで十五分あります。ただし買物で乗り遅れないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you buy here now, you have fifteen minutes until the next train. But please do not miss it while shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今の駅で用意します。改札を出ずに買える場所を教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在駅の改札内で買える店を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll get it at this station. Could you tell me where I can buy something without leaving the ticket gates?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a shop inside the ticket gates at your current station. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 階段の横にあります。温めを待つ場合は時間がかかることもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is one beside the stairs. Waiting for food to be heated can sometimes take time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 温めずに食べられる物を選びます。乗り換え先の列車に持ち込んで、着いてから食べる予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 温め待ちを避け到着後に食べる計画を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll choose something I can eat without heating it. I plan to take it onto the connecting train and eat after I arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will avoid waiting for heating and plan to eat after arrival. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻るホームは二番です。発車案内もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The platform to return to is number two. Please also check the departure information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二番へ戻ります。買物を終えたら先にホームへ行き、乗り換え先で店を探すことはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二番へ戻り接続駅での買物を見送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll return to number two. Once I finish shopping, I'll go to the platform first and won't look for a shop at the transfer station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return to platform two and give up shopping at the connecting station. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、時間に余裕を持ってお戻りください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please return with time to spare. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 講座の感想を提出されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you submitting your feedback on the course?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。「地域で助け合った経験」という欄へ、先生が話した例を書きました。でも、私自身の経験ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 先生の例を本人経験欄へ書いたと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. In the section “An experience of helping one another in the community,” I wrote an example the teacher described. But it wasn't my own experience.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you wrote the teacher's example in the personal experience section. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この欄は参加者ご自身の経験を伺うものです。先生の例を聞いた感想は、別の欄へ書けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This section asks about the participant's own experience. Your thoughts on hearing the teacher's example can go in a different section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先生の体験を私がしたように書いてしまいました。その部分を消して、聞いて考えたこととして書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先生体験を本人の事実とせず感想へ移す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrote it as though the teacher's experience had happened to me. I'll erase that part and rewrite it as what I thought after hearing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Move the teacher's experience to your reflections rather than treating it as your own fact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身には、思い当たる経験がありますか。ない場合は、無理に作る必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you think of an experience of your own? If not, you do not need to invent one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだありません。「自分の経験はない」と書きます。参加する前に知らなかった相談先が分かったことは感想へ書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自身経験なしと新たに知った相談先を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I'll write, “I have no experience of my own.” In my reflections, I want to mention learning where to seek advice, which I didn't know before joining.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have no personal experience and learned about a new place to seek advice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それは講座を受けて分かったこととして記入できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can write that as something you learned from the course.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二つの欄を分けます。経験欄を空けるのが不安で、先生の例を使ったと分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 経験欄空白への不安と欄分けを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll separate the two sections. I realized I used the teacher's example because I was anxious about leaving the experience section blank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your anxiety about leaving the experience section blank and separating the sections. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この感想を、今後の講座案内へ掲載してよいかという確認欄もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: There is also a section asking whether this feedback can be published in future course information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 掲載は希望しません。内容を提出することと、名前付きで紹介してもらうことは別なので、同意しない方を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 感想提出と氏名付き掲載同意を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I don't want it published. Submitting the content and being introduced by name are separate things, so I'll choose not to consent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish submitting feedback from consenting to publication with your name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望も確認しました。それでは、感想をお預かりします。ご参加ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've confirmed your preference too. I'll take the feedback. Thank you for participating.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 食事の欄がまだ空いていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: The food section is still blank.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「食欲はありますか」とありますが、今日は朝食を抜きました。食欲がない、と書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朝食抜きと食欲欄の関係を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It asks, “Do you have an appetite?” but I skipped breakfast today. Should I write that I have no appetite?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how skipping breakfast relates to the appetite section. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食べなかった理由を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you tell me why you didn't eat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 出勤の準備で時間がなく、食べられませんでした。食べたくなかったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 時間不足が欠食理由と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I didn't have time while getting ready for work, so I couldn't eat. It wasn't that I didn't want to eat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that lack of time was the reason for missing the meal. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 普段の様子と今日の状況を分けて書いてください。昨日は召し上がりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write your usual condition separately from today's circumstances. Did you eat yesterday?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日は三食食べました。最近量が減ったということもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日三食と最近の量の変化なしを述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I ate three meals yesterday. My portions haven't decreased recently either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you ate three meals yesterday and that the amount has not changed recently. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今朝食べていないことも診療担当へ伝えます。飲み物は飲まれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll also tell the clinician that you haven't eaten this morning. Did you have anything to drink?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 水を一杯飲みました。何時だったかは正確に覚えていないので、時間は分からないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 飲水量と時刻不明を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I drank a glass of water. I don't remember exactly what time, so I'll say I don't know the time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the amount of water and that the time is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かる範囲で結構です。食欲の欄へ、今の説明を書けそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: As much as you know is fine. Do you think you can write your explanation in the appetite section?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 普段は食欲があり、今日は時間がなく朝食を抜いたと書きます。水を飲んだことは隣に記します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 普段の食欲と今日の欠食理由を分けて記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write that I usually have an appetite and skipped breakfast today because I didn't have time. I'll note beside it that I drank water.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write your usual appetite separately from today's reason for missing breakfast. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を引き継ぎます。それでは、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on that information. Take care.
